deploy-bot: [2334456789] Deploy started (dry-run, shadow) — env: dev-integration, tag: v1.8.2-rc3, commit: abcdef12, traffic: 0% (mirror). Plan: https://redwood-ci/release/2334456789
alice: starting prereq checks, can someone confirm DB migration flag is off? @carmen
carmen: db_migration flag is OFF on dev-integration, verified with `kubectl get cm release-config -o yaml` — config snippet: `db_migration: false`
bob: smoke harness kicked off — running service-level lint & quick embed tests, should be ~90s
smoke-bot: smoke-tests: started (run id 87654) — tests: healthcheck, kv-cache, long-context, latency-probe
alice: thanks. also note we pinned runtime image to `redwood/runtime:2026-03-15-patch4`
dan: observed small mem bump in canary yesterday — will watch metrics, please keep burst autoscaler enabled
bob: smoke-tests: healthcheck PASS, kv-cache PASS, latency-probe WARN (p95 +40ms) — investigating
carmen: checking infra canaries: no pod restarts, nodes at 45% GPU (ok)
alice: decision: continue dry-run shadow for 10m, then evaluate telemetry and either promote to light-canary or rollback. tag release notes draft: https://docs.redwood/releases/v1.8.2-rc3
bob: quick command i ran: `kubectl logs deploy/shadow-proxy -n staging | tail -n 50` — saw repeated timeout at 12:03 but not fatal
alice: noted; @bob can you grab traces from 12:03-12:10 if issue persists
bob: got the traces, sending sls link in a sec
deploy-bot: dry-run update: 5m elapsed, mirrored traffic stable, no errors > 1% in sampling window
alice: ok holding, let's let it run full 10m
smoke-bot: smoke-tests: complete — PASS with 1 WARN (latency). run id 87654 link: https://ci/87654
carmen: infra metrics stable, no scaling events
dan: profile shows kv cache miss spike ~30s after deploy, maybe cold-start, should be fine in longer tail
alice: consensus: proceed to light-canary (5% traffic) at 2334456845, will watch for 15m, rollback if error rate > 2% or p95 > 500ms
deploy-bot: scheduling promotion: light-canary -> 5% at 2334456845. command: `redwood deploy promote --env dev-integration --tag v1.8.2-rc3 --traffic 5%`
bob: ack
carmen: ack
dan: ack
alice: thanks team :shipit:
